Feature: Virtual Clinic System Access and Administration
  As a System Administrator,
  I need to manage user access and system settings,
  So that the Virtual Clinic System can be used effectively.

  Scenario: User needs a valid login id/username and password to access the System
    Given a user attempts to log in to the System
    When the user enters a valid login id and password
    Then the user is granted access to the System

  Scenario: User id/login id and passwords will be maintained by Administrator
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator sets up a new user with a login id and password
    Then the new user's login id and password are stored in the system

  Scenario: Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Maintain Speciality
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Maintain Speciality option
    Then the Maintain Speciality screen is displayed

  Scenario: Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Maintain Doctors
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Maintain Doctors option
    Then the Maintain Doctors screen is displayed

  Scenario: Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Maintain Chemist & Labs
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Maintain Chemist & Labs option
    Then the Maintain Chemist & Labs screen is displayed

  Scenario: Virtual Clinic Main Menu - Maintain Symptoms
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Maintain Symptoms option
    Then the Maintain Symptoms screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators System Administrator Screens - Set-up Users/ Passwords
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Set-up Users/ Passwords option
    Then the Set-up Users/ Passwords screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators System Administrator Screens - Set-up Control File (for Pincode)
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Set-up Control File option
    Then the Set-up Control File screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators System Administrator Screens - Create Appointment File
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Create Appointment File option
    Then the Create Appointment File screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators System Administrator Screens - View/ Print Invoice
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the View/ Print Invoice option
    Then the View/ Print Invoice screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators System Administrator Screens - Back-ups
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Back-ups option
    Then the Back-ups screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators System Administrator Screens - Archive Patient Profiles
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Archive Patient Profiles option
    Then the Archive Patient Profiles screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrator Screen to Create Users - Doctor(s)
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Create Users screen
    And selects the Doctor(s) option
    Then the Create Doctor(s) screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrator Screen to Create Users - Chemists and Labs
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Create Users screen
    And selects the Chemists and Labs option
    Then the Create Chemists and Labs screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Speciality - Add Speciality
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Maintain Speciality screen
    And selects the Add Speciality option
    Then the Add Speciality screen is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Speciality - Edit/Update Speciality
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    When the Administrator navigates to the Maintain Speciality screen
    And selects the Edit/Update Speciality option
    Then the Edit/Update Speciality screen is displayed

  Scenario Outline: Add Speciality Screen - Speciality Id, Speciality Name, Speciality Description
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    And the Administrator is on the Add Speciality screen
    When the Administrator enters <Speciality Id>, <Speciality Name>, and <Speciality Description>
    Then the speciality is added to the system with the provided details

    Examples:
      | Speciality Id | Speciality Name | Speciality Description |
      | SP001         | Cardiology      | Heart and Circulatory System |
      | SP002         | Neurology       | Nervous System           |
      | SP003         | Pediatrics      | Children's Health        |

  Scenario Outline: Edit/ Update Speciality Screen - Query on Speciality Id, Speciality Name, Speciality Description
    Given the Administrator is logged into the System
    And the Administrator is on the Edit/Update Speciality screen
    When the Administrator queries for <Speciality Id>
    Then the speciality details <Speciality Name>, <Speciality Description> are displayed
    And the Administrator can modify or delete the speciality

    Examples:
      | Speciality Id | Speciality Name | Speciality Description |
      | SP001         | Cardiology      | Heart and Circulatory System |
      | SP002         | Neurology       | Nervous System           |
      | SP003         | Pediatrics      | Children's Health        |
